text: The bunker barge is alongside and the hose is connected. Diego, before we start: scuppers?
All scuppers are plugged, Chief.
Good. And the SOPEP locker is open and ready. We mustn't spill a drop.
Good afternoon. Lieutenant Chen, US Coast Guard. I'd like to watch the bunkering.
Of course, Lieutenant. Welcome on board.
Cadet, a few questions for you. Where is the SOPEP locker?
Next to the bunker station, on the port side.
What must you do if there's a spill on deck?
Stop the bunkering, report to the Chief Officer, and contain the oil with the spill kit.
And what mustn't you do?
We mustn't wash it overboard.
Correct. Short and clear. Who has to sign the bunker checklist?
The Chief Officer and the barge master.
Good. Carry on.
Well done, Diego. You answered like an officer.
Show me the barge.
Where's the hose?
Show me a scupper.
Where's the SOPEP locker?
Where's the oil boom?
Show me the spill.
Where do the bunkers go in?
Cadet, where is the SOPEP locker?
There's a spill on deck. What must you do?
Can I smoke here? Just one.
Who has to sign the bunker checklist?
Maximum rate: three hundred cubic metres per hour.
You don't have to wear the lifejacket here, but you must wear your helmet.
